★ Directly addresses governance and security of agentic AI systems in regulated financial environments—critical for Eidosmedia's AI governance strategy and financial services product R+.

Entrust announced the Agentic AI Trust Accelerator, a platform enabling financial institutions to deploy autonomous AI agents with verifiable identity and cryptographic trust. The solution addresses the governance gap between rapid agent deployment and regulatory requirements, providing institutions with tools to manage agent identity, access control, and auditability.
